### "echo f\t"
% echo file1
file1  file2  foo.c  foo.h
@ 0,12
### "\t"
% echo file2
file1  file2  foo.c  foo.h
@ 0,12
### "\t"
% echo foo.c
file1  file2  foo.c  foo.h
@ 0,12
### "\u{1b}[Z"
% echo file2
file1  file2  foo.c  foo.h
@ 0,12
### "\u{1b}[Z"
% echo file1
file1  file2  foo.c  foo.h
@ 0,12
### "\u{1b}[Z"
% echo foo.h
file1  file2  foo.c  foo.h
@ 0,12
